{"id":"JMAP-cayv.6","title":"jmap-server Session: i18n capability and preferredLanguages account capability (null for non-owned accounts)","description":"jmap-server Session: advertise urn:ietf:params:jmap:i18n ({}) only on opt-in, and the account capability with `preferredLanguages`.
- Add a backend hook returning Option<Vec<LanguageTag>> per account. How it is set is the deployment's business.
- The hook MUST return null (None) for accounts the requesting user does not own (draft Privacy Considerations, SHOULD; we enforce it in the helper so backends can't leak).
- Document in rustdoc: a server MAY use preferredLanguages for text written with no request in progress (push text). It MUST NOT use it to change /get or /query results.
